description: The runner's own control (`tools/runner-control.mjs`), played apart from the cases. `a-week-on-one-disk.json` is refused by `days/too-old`, and the runner has to report nothing of it as written. It has to report each variant besides, every one a rule no prepared case can prove, since every case is built to fire its own: without `carried`, `commits`, a case that passed; with `check` set to `commits`, a case that fired another check; with `rule` set to `too-many-commits`, a case that fired another rule.
